## Kimi K3

**Kimi K3** is now available on OmniMux.

See the Kimi complete page for the full model enum.

title.zh: Seedance 2.0 系列 — Standard / Mini / Fast

summary.zh: Seedance 2.0 视频 SKU 已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## Seedance 2.0

The **Seedance 2.0** family is available on OmniMux for async video generation.

### New models

| Model ID | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `seedance-2-0` | Standard |
| `seedance-2-0-mini` | Lightweight / cost-oriented |
| `seedance-2-0-fast` | Speed-oriented |

### API

- **Create:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Poll:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
body.zh:
## Seedance 2.0

**Seedance 2.0** 系列已在 OmniMux 可调用（异步视频）。

### 新模型

| 模型 ID | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| `seedance-2-0` | 标准档 |
| `seedance-2-0-mini` | 轻量 / 成本向 |
| `seedance-2-0-fast` | 速度向 |

### 调用

- **创建：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **查询：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
